title: First Cech acyclicity on cofinal finite open covers gives section lifting
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $0\to F\xrightarrow{i}G\xrightarrow{g}H\to0$ a short exact sequence of sheaves of abelian groups [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Let $B$ be a class of open subsets of $X$ and $\mathcal C$ a class of finite families of open subsets. Suppose every open covering of every $V\in B$ has a refinement $(U_i)_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)}\in\mathcal C$ covering $V$. Form the Cech complex with degree $p$ term $\prod_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)}F(U_{i_0}\cap\cdots\cap U_{i_p})$ and differential the alternating sum of restrictions. Suppose this complex is exact at degree $1$ for every family in $\mathcal C$. Then $g_V:G(V)\to H(V)$ is surjective for every $V\in B$.

proof.text: For s in H(V), short exactness gives a neighbourhood W_x of each x in V and a lift t_x of s restricted to W_x. Refine by a finite family U in C covering V and restrict the lifts to obtain a degree-zero G-cochain a whose image is the restriction of s. This is implemented by exists_app_g_eq_map and the refinement hypothesis in the existing complete source proof.

The difference cochain d(a) maps to zero in H. Sectionwise kernel exactness gives a unique F-valued degree-one cochain e with i(e)=d(a). Since d squared is zero and i is sectionwise injective, d(e)=0. Exactness at degree one supplies b with d(b)=e. Thus d(a-i(b))=0, while g(a-i(b)) is still the restriction of s. These are the explicit exists_cechComplex_map_f_eq, exactAt_cechComplex_iff and differential computations in the proved source declaration.

The corrected local sections agree on intersections. Glue them by the sheaf axiom of G; their image is s by separatedness of H and the covering condition. The existing surjective_app_of_exactAt_cechComplex_one proves this, and surjective_app_of_exactAt_cechComplex instantiates it with B and C. The empty covering of the empty open causes no exception: every sheaf has exactly one section there. This node ends at the attached already proved Lean declaration, rather than introducing any further proof obligation.
